items.passage: Transcript: Hi everyone, this is Keiko Ferrante at the recreation centre with next term's yoga schedule. Beginner yoga has met on Mondays at 6 p.m. in Room 341 for years, and intermediate yoga has followed it in the same room. Next term, intermediate yoga moves to Wednesdays at 7:30 p.m., in Room 409. We had planned to move the beginner class to that Wednesday evening slot as well, but we've dropped that idea, so the beginners aren't affected. A few of you asked whether the intermediate fee is going up. It isn't, and I'll still be the one teaching it. Just so you know, Room 409 fits eighteen mats, and last term we regularly had twenty-five people at intermediate sessions. Registration opens Friday at 9 a.m. at the front desk, or call extension 5216 if you can't come in.

"Mondays at 7:30 p.m." and "Wednesdays at 6 p.m." each pair the beginners' real day or time with the wrong other half.
